'''Kerred Santhe the Second''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the son of industrialist [[Kerred Santhe]], the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]]. Following his father's [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], the younger Santhe inherited ownership of his father's company and became the corporation's new leader. He embarked on a life of drinking and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. He reached debts of several millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] which threatened to publicize Santhe's predicament if the debts were not paid. Santhe feared that such a scandal would persuade the board of Santhe/Sienar to fire him and appoint his rival [[Narro Sienar]] as the corporation's new CEO, so he enlisted the help of a [[Unidentified Shi'ido|certain]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shi'ido]] gambler, who earned large amounts of gambling winnings and paid them into Santhe's bank account. However, Plagueis eventually learned of the Shi'ido's activities and put a stop to them and Sienar eventually succeeded Santhe as CEO.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kerred Santhe the Second was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
